newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close down, but sentiment remains good.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close down, but sentiment remains good.

text.p: Dutch bonds ended down on Thursday but below the midsession lows as the market shrugged off U.S. February retail data which came out above expectations.
U.S. retail sales, announced in the early afternoon, rose 0.8 percent in February, but a 0.6 percent rise was expected.
"It looks like the market is starting to believe U.S. economic data can be good without necessarily entailing inflationary pressures," one dealer said.
He added that recent U.S. economic data had pointed in that direction. "They seem to have things pretty much under control," he said.
